name: Spaceship b36f22f2 on 3.3.3.4.4
description: A period-18 spaceship on the elongated triangular tiling 3.3.3.4.4 (touching neighbours), 10 to 14 cells, moving one lattice step every 18 generations (c/18). It runs the same way in the 512 rules from B4567/S3478 to B4,5,6,7,9,10,11,12/S0,3,4,7,8,9,10,11,12; the scene uses the rule it was found in. Its live cells evolve the same way on k2-003, k2-004, k3-010 and k3-016, where the empty tiles around them have other neighbour counts, and on k3-013, k3-019, k3-051 and k3-052. The range of rules depends on the tiling: 512 rules on 3.3.3.4.4, k3-013, k3-019, k3-051 and k3-052; 32 rules on k2-003, k2-004, k3-010 and k3-016. JETCARP's soup search found it on k3-010 (seen 45 times). To our knowledge not reported before.
